title: scope-aware SQLite ledger, outbox fencing, guarded migration

acceptance_evidence.STORE-SCOPE: passed - cross-scope and unknown-id reads both raise SCOPE_DENIED (existence not revealed); scoped read returns control revision (TestScopeIsolation)
acceptance_evidence.STORE-CRASH: passed - injected OperationalError inside the command transaction leaves streams.revision, requests, events all rolled back (test_forced_error_rolls_back_all, test_con_rec_01)
acceptance_evidence.STORE-FENCE: passed - finish with a superseded fence raises STALE_LEASE; expired lease is re-claimable with a higher fence (test_stale_fence_finish_rejected, test_con_rec_04)
acceptance_evidence.STORE-FUTURE: passed - user_version 99 halts open() with FUTURE_SCHEMA; no downgrade or silent ignore (test_future_schema_refused)
acceptance_evidence.UH-RUN-01: passed - two commands at expected=0: first commits, second raises STALE_REVISION; revision stays 1 (test_stale_revision_rejected)
acceptance_evidence.UH-RUN-02: passed - record_observation advances event_seq only; control revision unchanged so approval binding stays valid (test_telemetry_does_not_bump_control_revision)
acceptance_evidence.UH-RUN-03: passed - same producer/producer_seq returns the original event_seq; conflicting payload raises IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (test_duplicate_producer_seq_deduped)
acceptance_evidence.UH-OPS-05: passed - apply_migration backs up via the SQLite backup API, applies DDL, verifies integrity/version, and restores the backup on failure (test_failed_migration_restores_backup)
acceptance_evidence.UH-RUN-05: passed - injected exception mid-transaction leaves events/requests/streams consistent (test_forced_error_rolls_back_all)
acceptance_evidence.INTEG-MIGRATION: passed - foundation DB is UNVERSIONED_DATABASE on open(); plan_migration returns explicit field_mapping + requires_backup; apply_migration renames legacy tables, applies target DDL, copies mapped rows under an explicit default_scope, and sets user_version=1 (test_plan_requires_backup_and_mapping, test_foundation_migration_applies_rows, test_open_never_merges_ddl)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-01: passed - claim that crashes before commit leaves the job pending (test_con_rec_01)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-02: passed - committed lease survives reopen; expired lease is re-claimable (test_con_rec_02)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-03: passed - write started but never settled is marked unknown, not failed (test_con_rec_03)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-04: passed - old owner with a stale fence cannot finish; new owner completes (test_con_rec_04)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-05: passed - tampered checkpoint body fails digest check with CORRUPT_CHECKPOINT (test_con_rec_05)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-06: passed - export_lag reports pending count while local ops continue (test_con_rec_06)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-07: passed - audit write failure on full DB maps to AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE; other errors propagate (test_con_rec_07)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-08: passed - committed cancel wins: cancelled job is never claimed (test_con_rec_08)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-09: passed - committed effect reservation dedupes replay; conflicting request raises IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (test_con_rec_09)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-10: passed - monotonic lease_floor prevents clock-backward lease expiry regression (test_con_rec_10)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-11: passed - tombstone recorded before restore wins over the restored row (test_con_rec_11)
acceptance_evidence.CON-REC-12: passed - mark_blocked preserves stream data and audit trail (test_con_rec_12)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-001: passed - reserve_node returns the same decision_id on re-entry; single row (test_resume_001)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-002: passed - out-of-order responses map by request_id (test_resume_002)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-003: passed - command payload approved=True raises WRONG_PURPOSE; payload booleans never grant approval (test_resume_003)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-005: passed - committed revoke blocks dispatch; cancelled job never claimed (test_resume_005)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-006: passed - dispatched-then-revoked effect becomes unknown, not applied (test_resume_006)
acceptance_evidence.RESUME-007: passed - stale-fence result returns 'stale'; usage_log bills the job exactly once (test_resume_007)

explicit_blocks: dev.py quality still exits 1 on pre-existing overlay-wide debt (532 line-length findings); all WP02-owned files are clean under the 79/72 Cyrano config

BasedPyright reports 0 errors and warning-level findings (reportAny/reportUnusedCallResult/reportImplicitStringConcatenation) consistent with the sqlite package baseline style (store.py carries the same classes)
not_established: native dcode runtime integration (component-level store only; WP03+ wires the kernel)
concurrent multi-process claim races under real OS scheduling (fencing logic tested serially)
known_limitations: Timestamps use literal 'now'/'0'/'migrated' markers pending the clock port in later WPs; meta_depth and deadline are stored as contract constants until the scheduler lands. Legacy foundation requests/outbox rows are renamed to foundation_* but not row-copied (streams and events are; requests lack scope data to map safely).
authority_scope: scope ACL, transaction atomicity, fencing, and migration guards only; no execution authority
